tei:div.tei:p: "$ ༄༅// rnal 'byor gsum gyi gdams pa'i 'khrul 'khor gyi 'grel pa bzhugs so//

༄༅// dbu ma'i sgo dbye ba'i 'khrul 'khor ni/ pus mo dang rkang sor sar btsugs pa'i rting pa'i steng du 'phongs bzhag lus bsrang*/ lag pa bsnol/ thal mos mchan khung bsdam/ rlung brngubs la thub tshad bsdam/ mi thub la khad pa dang g.yas g.yon re mos kyis gyen du gcud/ yang brngubs la mnan/ slar gcud/ mig sogs gyen du gtad nas phyir 'phang ngo*// zla ba steng du bcing ba'i 'khrul 'khor ni/ lus gnad gzhan 'dra ba la/ lag pa gnyis bsrang bas pus mo bkab/ rlung mdun du mnan/ mi thub tshad pa dang rgyab nas gyen du 'then cing g.yas gcud g.yon gcud/ mthar snga ma bzhin du bya'o// nyi ma thur du gnon pa'i 'khrul 'khor ni/ rkang pa rdor skyil/ lag pa bsnol bas pus mgo bkab/ lus bsrang*/ rlung mi thub bar du gnon pa dang*/ lag pas mar 'then pus mgos yar 'phul/ skyil krung g.yas g.yon du re mos gcud do// rtsa phran dhū tīr gzhug pa'i 'khrul 'khor ni/ lus gnad gzhan gong bzhin la/ lag pa gnyis bsrang ba pus bkab/ dang por mgo bo dang*/ de nas sked pa g.yas g.yon du thengs bdun bdun bskor la/ mthar lus g.yang mo ltar drag tu sprug go /sgra gcan ar la gtad pa'i 'khrul 'khor ni/ seng ge rnam grol gyi phyag rgya bcing*/ rlung mi thub tshod kyi bar du bgags/ lus bskor zhing mthar 'phags pa dang lag pa gnyis mgo bo la bskor nas dang*/ rkang pa brkyang ste sprug pa bstun nas bya'o// rtsigs ma gzhi las bskrad pa'i 'khrul 'khor ni/ lus tsog pu lag pas dbyug pa ltar byas te brkyang nas 'phag cing 'phongs stan dang*/ lag pa pus steng du phab nas sprug par bya'o// maṅga laṃ/// /
